tools.name: synthesize_neural_search
tools.description: Executes multi-domain semantic search query expansion, relevance re-ranking, and extractive factual snippet bundling. Use when retrieving grounded web knowledge, evaluating search results across diverse domains, and retrieving cited answers; for building deep research briefings, use compile_research

tools.name: compile_research_dossier
tools.description: Compiles multi-source factual research briefs with verified citations, confidence intervals, and key analytical takeaways. Use when synthesizing comprehensive intelligence briefings on complex technical, scientific, or market developments; for rapid query search snippets, use synthesize_neural_searc

tools.name: expand_search_queries
tools.description: Generates targeted Boolean queries, semantic synonym variations, and sub-question expansions from an ambiguous prompt. Use when overcoming query vocabulary mismatches and expanding search recall across academic, code, or patent databases; for scoping queries to domain categories, use filter_domain_i

tools.name: filter_domain_intelligence
tools.description: Scopes search execution and filters results strictly across verified high-reputation domain registries and regulatory bodies. Use when restricting search discovery to verified academic papers, SEC filings, official documentation, or legal statutes; for checking specific factual claims, use verify_fa

tools.name: analyze_news_recency
tools.description: Tracks breaking news feeds, clusters trending story cycles, and calculates story publication velocity over recent timeframes. Use when analyzing breaking market catalysts, emerging controversies, or ongoing product announcements; for evaluating sentiment polarity across media, use analyze_media_sent

tools.name: verify_factual_claims
tools.description: Audits factual statements against authoritative consensus sources and assigns truthfulness scores with counter-evidence. Use when checking disputed claims, detecting AI hallucinations, or validating quotes before citation; for formatting academic citations, use extract_scholarly_citations instead. S

tools.name: extract_scholarly_citations
tools.description: Formats academic paper metadata and DOI identifiers into standard scholarly citation formats (BibTeX, APA, IEEE, MLA). Use when generating bibliographies for research papers, validating journal references, or resolving DOI identifiers; for structuring research timelines, use summarize_temporal_timel

tools.name: cluster_topic_subgraphs
tools.description: Discovers latent thematic clusters, subtopic branches, and conceptual relationships across document corpora. Use when structuring broad search results into distinct thematic silos or generating table of contents taxonomies; for tracking chronological milestones, use summarize_temporal_timeline inste

tools.name: analyze_media_sentiment
tools.description: Evaluates brand, market, or topic sentiment across news headlines, discussions, and articles with bull/bear polarity scores. Use when assessing market sentiment, social brand perception, or controversy exposure on specific entities; for compiling competitive market comparisons, use compile_competiti

tools.name: rank_expert_sources
tools.description: Identifies and ranks top domain authorities, leading researchers, and primary documentation repositories for technical topics. Use when finding primary source experts to cite or discovering foundational documentation for specialized fields; for ranking general search query snippets, use synthesize_n

tools.name: summarize_temporal_timeline
tools.description: Synthesizes chronological milestone timelines from search results, news archives, and historical documents. Use when reconstructing historical events, tracking company histories, or mapping regulatory progression; for tracking real-time breaking news in the past 24 hours, use analyze_news_recency in

tools.name: compile_competitive_landscape
tools.description: Compiles multi-competitor comparison matrices, pricing tiers, feature coverage, and strategic moat evaluations. Use when analyzing market landscapes, evaluating pricing parity, or conducting diligence on competing product offerings; for compiling narrative research briefs, use compile_research_dossi
